QuestInfo.name: The Black Heart of Edelstein
QuestInfo.0: The Black Wings Hat is in your hands.
QuestInfo.1: You can get stronger while you spy on the Black Wings. Have #b#p1400003##k maneuver the #m150000000# into position near #b#m310000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: If things get dangerous, get back to the #m150000000# right away. Until then, find out everything you can about the Black Wings.

0.0: This hat isn't exactly the BEST disguise, but I'd look very silly in a mustache. At least the air's fresh and I don't have to train...
0.1: The monsters around #m310000000# seem pretty manageable too. Maybe this won't be a complete waste of time.
0.2: I just have to hide my identity and get back to the #m150000000# if things go south.

yes.0: #m310000000#, a phantom is coming to haunt you... as soon as I go talk to #p1400003#!

no.0: Maybe I'm not ready to jump into this. I've already got the hat, I could just go get stronger for a while...

1.0: As always, the Lumiere is at your command.
1.1: If you're ready to take her out for a ride across the wind, come talk to me.
1.2: I'm sure you've noticed, but #bthe Lumiere follows above you wherever you go#k. If you ever want to reboard the ship, you can #breturn to the Lumiere with that skill of yours#k.
